name: Wavered
source:
Claire is a detective going through a rough patch. Rarely sleeping due to a recent depression, she prefers to go to work to change her ideas.

That's when she comes across her old partner, Dion. As the day progress, she reminisce of the time they were working together...

[From [url=https://lunrae.itch.io/wavered]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克莱尔是一名侦探，正在经历一段艰难的时期。由于最近的抑郁症，她很少睡觉，她更愿意去工作来改变自己的想法。

就在那时，她遇到了她的老搭档迪翁。随着时间的推移，她回忆起他们一起工作的时光……

[来自[url=https://lunrae.itch.io/wavered]Itch.io[/url]]
